stepNeedsReview: Fix the issues in this step to continue. {detail}
configurationOffline: Reconnect to load the stored configuration.
configurationMismatch: The stored plan does not match this run.
storedCommandUnavailable: A standalone training command is not available for this stored plan. Use the resolved settings below.
cloneReviewHelp: This is an editable copy with the same name. Review a fresh plan before starting. Runtime environment values are not copied.
runtimeUnavailableModes: Some options are checked when you review
slurmPolicy: Cluster settings come from the server
environmentSecretsStayOnHost: Keep passwords and keys on the server
fastPresetHelp: Shorter exploratory training, not a duration guarantee.
balancedPresetHelp: Moderate epoch budget and early stopping.
accuracyPresetHelp: More epochs and patience; improved accuracy is not guaranteed.
exportValidationRequired: Fix the highlighted settings before exporting.
yamlExportFailed: Couldn’t download the YAML. Check your browser’s download settings and try again.
clipboardUnavailable: Couldn’t copy. Select the command and copy it yourself.
interpreterHelp: Full path to Python on the machine that runs training.
runtimeHelp: Device and machine setup are checked when you review the plan.
runtimeDetails: Device, precision and machine setup are checked when you review the plan. Bundled and container setups aren’t supported yet, and the Apple GPU can’t be chosen directly. Slurm account, partition, resources and storage mappings come from the server’s configuration.
environmentHelp: These values are included in the run.
environmentDetails: These values are saved with the run. Don’t enter passwords or keys here; set them up on the server instead.
environmentNameInvalid: Use a unique name. Some names are reserved by WaveDL.
customModelHelp: Enter a registered model ID. Compatibility is checked when you review the plan.
customModelFailed: Couldn’t select that model. Check your connection and try again.
connectionRequired: Connect to WaveDL to choose files and start runs.
resetHelp: Training fields reset; selections stay. Existing runs are unchanged.
submissionAckUnknown: We couldn’t confirm whether this started. Check your connection, then refresh the status before trying again. There’s no need to make a new draft.
planRefused: WaveDL couldn’t use these settings. Fix them and review again.
selectionRequired: Choose a dataset and model first.
selectionStale: Your dataset or model choice is out of date. Choose them again.
allSetHelp: Training keeps running if you leave.
sameTrainingWithWavedlCommandLine: Run the same training with the WaveDL command line. Paths are used as they are.
processesPerMachineCount: 1 process per machine | {count} processes per machine
